text:
alex_support: Customer reports a 401 on /v1/generate but says there is "no request-id" in their logs — asking what minimal info we should ask for to triage.
jamie_sre: Quick wins: ask for the exact UTC timestamp, full response headers (redacted values ok), and a Copy-as-cURL or HAR. headers usually contain our request id (x-rw-request-id or Request-Id).
alex_support: They said it's coming from a mobile webview and they can't find any x-rw header.
nina_mobile: For webview, have them open the browser devtools (remote if needed) -> Network -> find the failed request -> right-click -> Copy -> Copy as cURL. The cURL preserves all headers we need. Also check console logs for our SDK's `requestToken` log. Example console line:```
Error: Unauthorized
requestToken: "req_abc123"
```
owen_backend: If it's native mobile (iOS/Android) tell them to search device logs for `requestToken` or `req_` prefix. Our Android SDK prints:```
E/RedwoodSDK: request failed status=401 token=req_202
```
alex_support: What if customer cannot share headers or HAR for privacy reasons?
jamie_sre: Then ask for this minimal checklist: 1) UTC timestamp of the failed request (include timezone), 2) endpoint + HTTP method, 3) SDK name + version + platform, 4) redacted response headers (show header names only), 5) exact status code and response body (redact any PII), 6) whether a proxy/CDN sits in front (and its correlation header if any).
nina_mobile: For Hosted Console customers: they can also go Console -> Support -> Activity -> Download last 24h logs (if available) which includes request ids. For Private customers, ask them to run the debug collector. Example command for on-prem:```
# run on control plane host
rwctl collect-debug --since "2026-03-16T00:00:00Z" --out /tmp/rw-debug.zip
```
support-bot: Note: escalation tip — if you get a redacted cURL, search the cURL for `-H 'x-rw-request-id:` or `-H 'Request-Id:`. If present, include it in the ticket.
owen_backend: Also check billing/quota headers — a 401 can be caused by expired auth or billing flags. Ask them to include `x-plan-id` or any `x-quota-*` headers if they see them.
alex_support: Can we provide a tiny template for the customer to paste?
nina_mobile: Yep — paste this:```
Timestamp (UTC): 2026-03-16T14:22:05Z
Endpoint: POST /v1/generate
SDK: web-js 2.4.1
Copy-as-cURL: (paste here) or HAR attached
Headers: (list header names, redacted values OK)
Response body: { "error": "Unauthorized" }
Request token: (if shown)
```
jamie_sre: Also add: exact timezone, and whether they hit any intermediate proxy or WAF. If they can't run devtools, a screenshot of the response headers in their network tab is helpful.
alex_support: Great — I'll send this checklist + template in the customer reply. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
support-bot: Reminder: attach `needs-trace` tag to the ticket so eng can pick it up if we get a request token.
